basic_details.scholarship_name: Global UGRAD Pakistan Undergraduate Exchange Program
basic_details.offering_entity: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP) & U.S. Department of State (ECA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Accredited U.S. Colleges and Universities across all 50 states (Placement arranged by IREX / USEFP)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all academic disciplines (Engineering, CS, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Business, Arts, Humanities, Agriculture). Clinical medical rotations not permitted; pre-med coursework allowed.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 240 Pakistani students per annual cycle
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: 100% reserved exclusively for Pakistani citizens enrolled in Pakistani universities
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 1 academic semester (~4.5 months) in the United States

nationality_requirements: Pakistani citizen currently residing in Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be between 18 and 25 years of age at the time of program entry.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Currently enrolled in a 4-year bachelor's (16-year education) or 2-year bachelor's degree program at an accredited Pakistani university. Must have at least one semester remaining upon return to Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 2.50 / 4.00 CGPA; however, competitive admitted scholars generally present 3.20+ CGPA or top 15% class standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Any accredited university subject background in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must be enrolled in 14th or 15th year of education (e.g., 2nd or 3rd year of 4-year BS, or 1st year of 2-year BS). Final semester students are NOT eligible.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must not be graduating before the exchange semester; must return to home university in Pakistan to complete remaining degree requirements.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Volunteering, community service, and extracurricular leadership heavily prioritized over formal corporate work.

english_proficiency.notes: No TOEFL/IELTS required to apply. Shortlisted candidates are sponsored by USEFP to take official TOEFL iBT test free of charge.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; English is the medium of instruction in the U.S.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; female applicants, students from underserved provinces (Balochistan, KP, interior Sindh, GB, AJK), and persons with disabilities actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Strong commitment to return and contribute to community development in Pakistan; active leadership track record.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Individuals with previous long-term U.S. exchange or travel grants are lower priority; dual U.S. citizens or green card holders strictly ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: Full undergraduate tuition and mandatory university campus fees paid directly to host U.S. institution.

admission_application_fee.details: No admission application fees; USEFP manages placement and administration.

accommodation.details: Standard university on-campus residence hall (shared room with roommate) fully paid for the duration of the semester.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly personal living allowance for incidentals.

airfare.details: Round-trip international economy class airfare from home city in Pakistan to the host university in the United States.

visa_fee.details: Full sponsorship of J-1 exchange visitor visa; SEVIS and visa application fees covered.

health_insurance.details: Accident and Sickness Program for Exchanges (ASPE) health benefit coverage provided by the U.S. Department of State.

food_allowance.details: Full on-campus dining meal plan (14 to 21 meals per week) included alongside dormitory accommodation.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Textbook and academic course supplies stipend provided upon arrival.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Not applicable to undergraduate exchange semester.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Domestic transit in Pakistan to visa appointment and departure hub covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions assigned centrally across all 50 U.S. states.
participating_institutions: Dozens of partner institutions across the USA
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Comprehensive mix of Top 100 research universities and regional liberal arts colleges.
available_majors: All majors: Engineering, Computer Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Business, Economics, International Relations, Psychology, Media Studies, Agriculture
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 academic semester (Fall: Aug-Dec OR Spring: Jan-May)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Handled entirely via USEFP selection; no separate university admission application is needed.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Institutions are assigned by IREX/USEFP based on academic fit, field, and campus environment; applicants cannot choose or change their host college.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus your essays on cultural exchange, cross-cultural diplomacy, and what specific community challenges in Pakistan you will address upon return.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the USEFP portal with primary Pakistani email, national CNIC, and current university student enrollment details.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register online account on USEFP portal during the open window (September/October).
2. Upload scanned official university academic transcripts from all completed semesters.
3. Write Statement of Purpose essay detailing personal background, community leadership, and exchange vision.
4. Provide contact details of two academic referees or professors who will upload reference letters directly.
5. Submit complete online dossier before the annual deadline (usually mid-November).
6. Shortlisted applicants invited to panel interviews at USEFP Islamabad or regional hubs.
7. Final selected candidates take sponsored TOEFL test and attend mandatory pre-departure orientation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct single application through USEFP Pakistan portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by university professors via secure referee link sent by USEFP.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Address your leadership experiences, extracurricular activities, your perspective as a cultural ambassador for Pakistan in the U.S., and your future goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief statement of intended coursework and areas of academic interest to be pursued during the semester.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard 1-2 page academic & extracurricular resume highlighting volunteerism, leadership positions, and community initiatives.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-30 minute structured panel interview conducted in English by USEFP staff and U.S. Embassy officers in Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi or virtual.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None at application time; TOEFL iBT administered and funded by USEFP only for shortlisted finalists.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $0 (100% Free - USEFP never charges an application fee)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by university registrar or controller of examinations; HEC/IBCC attestation not required at initial application stage.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: All university transcripts must be issued in English.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official university transcripts of all completed semesters with university grading scale
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by your university examination department or controller of examinations

required_documents_checklist.specification: Valid National Identity Card issued by NADRA
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned copy of both front and back sides

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured essay (around 500-750 words) answering official prompt
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Original narrative demonstrating leadership and community impact; zero plagiarism tolerated

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters from university faculty members
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Uploaded directly by university professors using official institutional email

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letter from department head confirming current active student status and permission for semester abroad
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued on university letterhead with official stamp

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual cycle opens every autumn (September-October) with 240 Pakistani students split across Fall and Spring cohorts.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 35% (Community engagement, volunteer work, youth initiatives, leadership)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Clarity of purpose, authenticity, cultural exchange aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Significant in final round (English fluency, cultural adaptability, confidence)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: USEFP education advisers, U.S. Embassy and Consular public diplomacy diplomats, and Pakistani alumni.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review with strong geographic representation across all provinces of Pakistan.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Dynamic undergraduate students with active volunteer work, debate/MUN, blood drive organizing, or teaching underprivileged children.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from diverse universities: NUST, FAST, LUMS, IBA, Punjab University, UET, Quaid-i-Azam, UET Peshawar, BUITEMS Quetta, Karakoram International University.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unverified Facebook/Instagram pages claiming to guarantee UGRAD selection for money.
Consultants asking for money to write UGRAD essays.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: USEFP NEVER charges an application fee. The application is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do NOT hire education agents. USEFP explicitly states third-party agent applications are penalized.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Domestic travel to Islamabad/Karachi/Lahore for U.S. visa interview and pre-departure orientation (though modest travel stipend is provided to distant candidates).
NADRA Smart Card / Passport renewal fees in Pakistan.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Only students from top elite private universities get selected. (Fact: High priority is given to public sector regional universities across KP, Balochistan, Sindh, and GB).
MYTH: You can stay in the USA and transfer into a full degree. (Fact: Strictly prohibited; students must return to Pakistan to complete their home degree under J-1 visa terms).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs claim IELTS is required; officially, NO IELTS or TOEFL is needed at the time of application.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and full-time enrollment (minimum 12 credits) at host U.S. university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory class attendance and full participation in 20 hours of community service during the semester in the U.S.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host university advisor submits midterm and final grade reports to IREX and USEFP.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under the J-1 Global UGRAD visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY Return: Must return immediately to Pakistan upon semester completion to resume degree at home university; subject to 2-year home country physical presence requirement (Section 212(e)).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligated to complete remaining undergraduate studies in Pakistan and participate in the Pakistan-U.S. Alumni Network (PUAN).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Violations of U.S. law, university honor code, or unauthorized travel/stay will result in immediate termination, deportation, and recovery of costs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: University assignment is final and cannot be altered.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Course selection is coordinated with host academic advisor within student's home major.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are strictly prohibited; program is limited to exactly one academic semester.
